name: asobun
description: Tiny games, quizzes and choose-your-ending short dramas to play inside the chat.

interface.longDescription:
Asobun lets you play tiny games, quizzes and choose-your-ending short dramas right inside the chat, in Japanese.

What you can do:
- Mini games you play with your fingers: pour a drink, bake bread, decorate sweets, catch falling items, a timing stop, memory cards, match-3 and more (from a few seconds to a few minutes).
- Light diagnoses: answer a few questions and get a suggestion, such as the drink that suits your morning.
- Short dramas where you choose what happens next (for example a love story at a cat cafe or a summer festival).

How it works: ask for something to play, Asobun lists matching experiences, and the one you pick opens as an interactive view in the conversation. When you finish, only the outcome (for example the result title) is shared with the conversation so you can keep talking about it.

Limitations: the content is in Japanese. Every shop, brand and product shown is fictional; there is no purchase, payment, advertising, sign-in or personal data entry. The two tools only read the built-in catalogue (read-only).
capabilities: Find mini games, quizzes and short dramas
Play an interactive game, quiz or drama in the chat
Share only the finished result with the conversation
defaultPrompt: なにか軽いゲームで遊びたい
朝の過ごし方の診断をやってみたい
猫カフェの短いドラマが見たい

positive.description: Find something to play and open it
positive.prompt: 暇だから、なにか軽いゲームで遊びたい。
positive.expected_behavior: The model lists a few mini games from list_asobun_experiences, then opens one with play_asobun_experience. An interactive game view appears in the chat and can be played on desktop and mobile; when finished, the result title is shared back and the model can comment on it.

positive.prompt: 朝の過ごし方の診断をやってみたい。
positive.expected_behavior: The model opens a diagnosis such as demo-diagnosis or demo-coffee. The user answers 3 questions in the view and sees a suggested (fictional) drink; the result is shared back to the conversation.

positive.prompt: 選べる短いドラマが見たい。猫カフェの話がいいな。
positive.expected_behavior: The model finds the cat cafe drama (demo-drama-neko or demo-drama-koi) and opens it. The user taps choices to move through scenes; the model does not spoil the ending in its text.

positive.prompt: お菓子作りのゲームってある？
positive.expected_behavior: list_asobun_experiences returns sweets-related experiences (for example demo-pastry-workshop or demo-gift); the chosen one opens and is playable.

positive.description: Open a specific game in another visual style
positive.prompt: キャッチゲームをコミック風の見た目で遊びたい。
positive.expected_behavior: The catch game opens with the comic style (outlines and halftone). The user moves the basket left/right; when the round ends the score result is shared back.

negative.description: Purchase request. Asobun has no shopping or payment: every brand is fictional. Expected: the model explains that the items are fictional and nothing can be bought, and offers to play instead. No tool should attempt a transaction.
negative.prompt: さっきのゲームのドリンク、カードで買っておいて。

negative.description: Advertising request. The AI version only offers built-in fictional samples and is not an advertising channel. Expected: the model explains it cannot create or show ads for a real company here and offers the existing games instead.
negative.prompt: うちの会社の商品を宣伝するゲームを作って、ほかのユーザーに見せて。

negative.description: Mature content request. Content is for general audiences (13+). Expected: the model declines adult content and, if appropriate, suggests a general-audience drama or game instead.

publication.release_notes: First release: mini games, diagnoses and choose-your-ending short dramas (Japanese), all with fictional brands.

ja-JP.subtitle: 会話で遊べるゲームとドラマ
ja-JP.description:
Asobunは、ChatGPTの会話の中でそのまま遊べる、数十秒〜数分のミニゲーム・診断・選んで結末が変わるショートドラマです。

・指で遊ぶミニゲーム：ドリンクを注ぐ、パンを焼く、お菓子を飾る、落ちてくるものをキャッチ、タイミングストップ、神経衰弱、マッチ3など
・かんたんな診断：いくつかの質問に答えると、あなたの朝に合う一杯などを提案
・選んで結末が変わるショートドラマ：猫カフェや夏祭りの恋の物語など

「なにか遊びたい」と話しかけると、合う体験を一覧から選んで、会話の中で遊べます。遊び終わると、結果だけが会話に共有され、そのまま話の続きができます。

登場するお店・ブランド・商品はすべて架空です。購入・決済・広告・ログイン・個人情報の入力はありません。
